Workers, facades, and STs introduced lazily at first use.
All call signatures are the as-designed facade — translate directly to Rust source.
Receiver (&self / &mut self) is implicit in the lifeline.
SharedState is the Arc[T] every worker holds — initiator-side calls touch Sess, worker-side calls touch Shared.

GotObserver registration (extension point per facades/backend.md §"GOT-population observation") happens once at session init from int when REPL/trace mode or CRANELISP_GOT_TRACE=1 is active. Production batch: no observer registered, one relaxed null-check load per emit site.

After Phase 0 the SymbolTable is reachable only via shared .get() — workers run with [&SymbolTable] + per-entry inner locks.
PHASE 0 — synchronous setup before scheduler dispatch
RefMut DROPS — Phase 0 over.

CompilerSession::wait_for_inmem_codegen — until all in-mem code is loaded

Scheduler invariants —
at most ONE worker per module during typecheck (ORDERING per Decision 30 — no longer required for lock safety).
Per-symbol mutability via inner DashMap per-key locks (Decisions 25, 33, 38).
Wait/release is per-symbol or per-module readiness.
TYPECHECK PHASE
Workers operate on &SymbolTable via Sess.shared.symbol_tables.get. Cache hit via sidecar skips the cluster loop entirely.
Per Decision 44 the typecheck surface is a single free function check_forms. The orchestrator process_cluster in the int crate drives it across one cluster.
A cluster is one form for non-begin REPL input, or contents of a begin-block for explicit REPL clusters, or the file non-structural forms for batch one-big-cluster.

check_forms takes Vec of ParsedEntry plus mutable ClusterContext plus SymbolTables and returns Result of CheckError. Internally Pass 1 registers signatures, Pass 2 checks bodies. Pass-1-to-Pass-2 working state lives inside check_forms frame and never crosses the facade.

typecheck reads via ctx.current_symbol_table which returns a View union of staging and live in Cluster mode, and writes via ctx.current_symbol_table_mut which returns mutable staging. The 91 register-call sites in program.rs do not change individually.

orchestrator owns a transient staging SymbolTable for the cluster, held under mutable borrow inside ClusterContext::Cluster, and commits via insert_cluster atomically into the live SymbolTable on success.

On Err of TypeError staging dissolves with the function frame. Live table is byte-identical to pre-cluster state. On Err of Gap the orchestrator drops staging and retries the whole check_forms call against a fresh staging frame.
install entries from cached sidecar — overwrite Sess.shared.symbol_tables[m1] with deserialised value
(this is the one cache-hit case where Phase 0's seed value is replaced wholesale, brief entry write lock)
dedicated cache-hit notification —
Sched releases all m1/* typecheck waiters and enqueues PriorityWork::LoadObject(m1)
(.o assumed paired with sidecar — no per-symbol Jit items, no separate ObjectCodegen pass)
Phase 0 already ran in register_module — structural decls are present.
Defn authorship ordering is per-entry (ModuleEntry::Def.seq allocated at form-loop insert via SymbolTable::next_seq.fetch_add(1)).
Worker proceeds directly to the form loop with [&SymbolTable] via Sess.shared.symbol_tables.get(m1).
process_cluster is the orchestrator. Signature — shared ref to SharedState, forms as Vec of Sexp, scope as ref to m1. Per Decision 44 amended by FIXME 0167 — 2026-05-13 third amendment.
Frontend stays pure — no live mutation. Typecheck stays pure with respect to live state — mutates orchestrator-handed staging via ctx.current_symbol_table_mut.
Neither has a Sess or scheduler dependency — they SURFACE dependencies as Err of ExpansionError.Gap of ResolutionGap, or Err of CheckError.Gap of ResolutionGap.
process_cluster catches each gap and dispatches via handle_gap — ensure_registered then wait then priority_boost plus wait_for_inmem — and RETRIES the call.
Workers park inside scheduler wait_* — never inside library code. See facades/int.md section "process_cluster — the cluster-atomic orchestration loop".

Inner loops below — step 1, per-form expand plus build_form accumulating vec of ParsedEntry. Step 2, single check_forms call from cranelisp_typecheck internally running Pass 1 then Pass 2. Step 3, cluster-atomic drain into live via insert_cluster.
process_form's handle_gap dispatch on MacroInMem — uniform regardless of whether m2/sym turns out to be a macro or a fn:
PW releases m1 and parks. Resumes when m2/sym typecheck-done (may be different priority worker on resume).
Orchestrator-side macro-vs-fn discrimination — peek at the now-typechecked entry:
PW parks. Sched promotes Jit(m2/sym) to head of priority queue.
Some worker JITs m2/sym — on completion Sched releases the wait.

Multi-clause defmacro emits one parent Def of kind Macro — metadata only — plus one Def of kind UserFn per clause body under mangled name {macro}$clause-{N} per cranelisp_types::DefKind::Macro.
deftype emits the type Def plus one Constructor-kind Def per ctor per D49.

After expand plus build_form has accumulated vec of ParsedEntry for every form in the cluster, the orchestrator makes one cranelisp_typecheck::check_forms call.

Multi-clause defmacro yields one parent Macro-kind Def plus N clause-body UserFn Defs under {macro}$clause-{N} names. deftype-with-constructors yields the type Def plus N Constructor-kind Defs. Both shapes produce multiple ParsedEntry items per source form.

Per Decision 44 — amended by FIXME 0167 for Approach B plus ClusterContext, and 2026-05-13 third amendment collapsing the two-pass split — check_forms internally runs Pass 1 to register signatures, then Pass 2 to check bodies across all parsed entries.

The orchestrator constructs ClusterContext.Cluster carrying modules, staging as mutable ref to empty_staging, and current_module once per cluster, then threads &mut ctx through the single check_forms call.
Typecheck mutates staging via ctx.current_symbol_table_mut — cluster-atomic drain at the end. Pass-1-to-Pass-2 working state lives inside check_forms frame and never crosses the facade.

Decision 44 third amendment — pure with respect to live state. Staging mutation flows through ctx.current_symbol_table_mut — same accessor used in committed-mode. The 91 register-call sites in typecheck program.rs do NOT change individually.
Pass 2 bodies check against ctx.current_symbol_table which returns a union View over staging and live in Cluster mode — cluster signatures from Pass 1 visible to Pass 2 internally.

process_cluster handle_gap dispatch on SymbolTypechecked. Per FIXME 0160 plus Decision 44 third amendment — live table is unchanged. Orchestrator drops the staging frame and retries the whole check_forms call against a fresh staging frame.
PW releases m1 and parks. Typecheck waits do NOT priority-boost — m2 typecheck progresses naturally.

After check_forms returns Ok, the orchestrator drops ctx — releases the &mut staging borrow — and int::insert_cluster commits staging into the live SymbolTable atomically. Per-entry inner DashMap writes — no whole-module lock.

Order matters for ADT — type Def then Constructor-kind Defs per D49 — and multi-clause defmacro — parent Macro-kind metadata Def then each clause-body UserFn Def under {macro}$clause-{N} per cranelisp_types::DefKind::Macro. Order is preserved by build_form emission order, threaded through staging.
